editorial_thesis: The practical frontier is the operating loop: discover delegated work, bind authority, measure outcomes, and keep the next experiment reversible.

topic_groups.title: Agent Identity + Governance
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh November signals converge on one practical gap: organizations have agents in production, but identity, ownership, authorization, and runtime observability remain fragmented.

sources.title: SailPoint Agentic Fabric reaches GA
sources.why_selected: It models the whole action path—owner → credential → entitlement → tool → data—instead of treating an agent as an isolated inventory record.
sources.usefulness: Use the lineage shape as a Buildn design reference: every job should expose its human owner, execution identity, tools, artifacts, and reachable data.

sources.title: State of AI Agent Security 2026
sources.why_selected: The reported gap is concrete: 80.9% are past planning, but only 14.4% say all agents receive full approval; 45.6% still use shared API keys for agent-to-agent auth.
sources.usefulness: Turn the numbers into a client discovery checklist: inventory, independent identities, approval gates, telemetry coverage, and orphaned credentials.

sources.title: Broadcom AgentMinder + Private AI Cloud
sources.why_selected: It treats MCP servers, tools, models, datastores, and agents as one connected attack surface rather than separate products.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the layered control model for client architectures: discover → bind identity → restrict intent → observe actions → block misuse.

sources.title: Microsoft governance and security baseline
sources.why_selected: It makes the baseline enforceable and auditable, with named layers and a control-plane view rather than a loose policy document.
sources.usefulness: Use its four-layer framing to structure Buildn/client readiness reviews: development, agent security, observability, data governance.

topic_groups.title: Engineering Proof + Agentic Development
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coverage has repeatedly surfaced coding agents; today’s fresher angle is the proof gap: how to quantify quality, cost, throughput, and governance once agents become continuous production infrastructure.

sources.title: State of AI in Engineering 2026: The Proof Gap
sources.why_selected: 96.4% report AI coding-tool use, but only 20% measure productivity specifically; 72% operate on self-report or no evidence.
sources.usefulness: Use it to sell measurement as a Buildn/client service: instrument task acceptance, rework, review time, defects, and spend—not tokens alone.

sources.title: Dependabot supports Agent Package Manager
sources.why_selected: As agent projects add skills, tools, and model-facing packages, dependency hygiene becomes part of the agent supply chain—not just application maintenance.
sources.usefulness: Add automated dependency review to agent repositories and require provenance for skills, plugins, and tool adapters.

sources.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows GA
sources.why_selected: The important design move is to make delegated work a versioned repository artifact with explicit triggers, models, and reviewable changes.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a Buildn job as a checked-in workflow: typed input, bounded permissions, output artifact, reviewer gate, and rollback path.

sources.title: Code scanning for AI applications
sources.why_selected: AI-generated code increases review volume; security checks need to run where patches are proposed, not after deployment.
sources.usefulness: Add an AI-app security lane to client delivery: prompt/tool boundaries, secret handling, dependency risk, data-flow checks, and evidence in the PR.

topic_groups.title: Physical AI + Open Robotics
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A coverage gap in the last two dossiers: fresh NVIDIA material gives a concrete open-source path from simulation and synthetic data to agentic robot software.

sources.title: Isaac ROS 5.0
sources.why_selected: It exposes a practical bridge between language-level planning and ROS-native perception, navigation, and control components.
sources.usefulness: Study the decomposition for future Buildn physical-workflow prototypes: planner, tool adapter, simulator, safety monitor, and artifact log.

sources.title: Isaac GR00T open models
sources.why_selected: The useful unit is not a chatbot response but a grounded action policy that can be evaluated in a simulated or physical environment.
sources.usefulness: Use the VLA framing to compare agent workflows with embodied workflows: observation, plan, action, feedback, recovery.

sources.title: NVIDIA physical AI research roundup
sources.why_selected: It frames robotics as a data-and-simulation problem as much as a model problem, which is the more transferable insight for small teams.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the loop for client automation: generate constrained scenarios, test policies, capture failures, and iterate before field deployment.

sources.title: OpenUSD-based simulation and synthetic data
sources.why_selected: Synthetic environments can make rare, risky, or expensive scenarios testable before a robot touches production equipment.
sources.usefulness: Apply the pattern to client process simulation and visual QA even without a robot: synthetic edge cases, labeled states, and repeatable evaluation.

topic_groups.title: Models, Learning + Operator Leverage
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This lane follows a neglected personal-leverage gap while staying practical: new model and education surfaces are useful only if they shorten the path from curiosity to repeatable skill.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon for developers
sources.why_selected: A limited introductory window creates a concrete opportunity for a controlled task comparison rather than vague model shopping.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark it against a fixed set of Buildn tasks: research synthesis, code repair, structured extraction, and artifact generation.

sources.title: AI Agents Intensive course
sources.why_selected: A time-boxed curriculum can turn ambient agent interest into a deliberate learning sprint with exercises and a shared vocabulary.
sources.usefulness: Use the syllabus as a gap audit for Buildn: tools, state, evaluation, security, deployment, and human review.

sources.title: Expanding AI educator training
sources.why_selected: The feedback loop matters: effective AI adoption depends on role-specific practice, not one-time tool exposure.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the cohort pattern for client enablement: short lessons, concrete tasks, office hours, and revisions from observed friction.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro developer lessons
sources.why_selected: The durable operator lesson is rapid, feedback-driven iteration around task performance rather than abstract version tracking.
sources.usefulness: Keep a tiny regression suite of personally relevant tasks and rerun it whenever a model or prompt stack changes.
